body.en:
Pipe materials and uses:

  • Ductile iron: strong pressure mains with suitable internal lining and external corrosion protection.
  • Steel: large diameter or high pressure and special crossings; corrosion control and joint quality are important.
  • PVC/uPVC and HDPE: lightweight corrosion-resistant pipes, selected for pressure rating, temperature and installation conditions.
  • Concrete and other approved materials: selected for specific large-diameter or non-pressure applications; assess loading and water quality.

Joints: socket-and-spigot with rubber gasket, flanged, threaded, welded steel and heat-fused HDPE joints suit different materials and pressures. Follow the approved manufacturer procedure; joint compatibility, restraint, watertightness and thrust control matter.
body.gu:
Pipe materials અને ઉપયોગ:

  • Ductile iron: યોગ્ય internal lining અને external corrosion protection સાથે મજબૂત pressure mains.
  • Steel: મોટા diameter અથવા high pressure તથા special crossings માટે; corrosion control અને joint quality મહત્વનાં છે.
  • PVC/uPVC અને HDPE: હળવા corrosion-resistant pipes; pressure rating, temperature અને installation conditions પ્રમાણે પસંદ કરો.
  • Concrete અને અન્ય approved materials: ચોક્કસ મોટા diameter અથવા non-pressure applications માટે; loading અને water quality તપાસો.

Joints: rubber gasket સાથે socket-and-spigot, flanged, threaded, welded steel અને heat-fused HDPE joints અલગ materials અને pressures માટે યોગ્ય છે. Approved manufacturer procedure અનુસરો; joint compatibility, restraint, watertightness અને thrust control મહત્વનાં છે.

body.en:
Typical sequence:

  1. Survey alignment, utilities, elevations, permissions and traffic controls.
  2. Excavate with engineered trench support and safe access; never enter an unsupported hazardous trench.
  3. Prepare suitable bedding, inspect pipes, lower without damage, align and assemble clean joints.
  4. Provide specified thrust restraint at bends, tees, dead ends and valves; install valve chambers and access.
  5. Backfill and compact in specified layers; protect the pipe and prevent damage from large stones.
  6. Pressure/leak-test, flush, disinfect and sample according to the approved standard and authority procedure before commissioning.

Keep clean-water mains separated from contamination sources and prevent backflow. Site-specific design and manufacturer instructions govern.
body.gu:
સામાન્ય sequence:

  1. Alignment, utilities, elevations, permissions અને traffic controls survey કરો.
  2. Engineered trench support અને safe access સાથે excavation કરો; unsupported જોખમી trench માં પ્રવેશ ન કરો.
  3. યોગ્ય bedding તૈયાર કરી pipes તપાસો, નુકસાન વગર નીચે ઉતારો, align કરો અને સ્વચ્છ joints બનાવો.
  4. Bends, tees, dead ends અને valves પર નિર્દિષ્ટ thrust restraint આપો; valve chambers અને access બનાવો.
  5. નિર્દિષ્ટ layers માં backfill અને compact કરો; મોટા પથ્થરોથી pipe ને નુકસાન ન થાય તેની કાળજી લો.
  6. Commissioning પહેલાં approved standard અને authority procedure મુજબ pressure/leak-test, flushing, disinfection અને sampling કરો.

Clean-water mains ને contamination sources થી અલગ રાખો અને backflow અટકાવો. Site-specific design અને manufacturer instructions અનુસરો.

body.en:
Distribution by energy source:

  • Gravity: water flows from a sufficiently high reservoir; reliable when pressure and elevation are adequate.
  • Direct pumping: pumps feed the network; power failure or pump breakdown can interrupt service.
  • Combined: pumps fill an elevated reservoir that helps balance demand and pressure.

Network patterns: dead-end/tree is simple but stagnant ends need flushing; grid and ring layouts provide alternative flow paths but need more valves and pipe; radial systems supply zones from central points. Hydraulic design must check peak demand, fire flows where required, pressure and water age.

Continuous versus intermittent: continuous pressurised supply reduces intrusion risk when maintained properly; intermittent operation may allow contamination through leaks during low pressure and requires controlled storage. Neither label guarantees safe water without maintenance.
body.gu:
Energy source મુજબ distribution:

  • Gravity: પૂરતી ઊંચાઈના reservoir માંથી પાણી વહે છે; pressure અને elevation પૂરતાં હોય ત્યારે વિશ્વસનીય છે.
  • Direct pumping: pumps સીધા network ને પાણી આપે છે; power failure અથવા pump breakdown થી સેવા બંધ થઈ શકે.
  • Combined: pumps elevated reservoir ભરે છે, જે demand અને pressure balance કરવામાં મદદ કરે છે.

Network patterns: dead-end/tree સરળ છે, પરંતુ stagnant ends ને flushing જોઈએ; grid અને ring માં alternative flow paths મળે છે પણ વધુ valves તથા pipes જોઈએ; radial systems માં central points થી zones ને supply મળે છે. Hydraulic design માં peak demand, જરૂરી fire flows, pressure અને water age તપાસો.

Continuous અને intermittent: યોગ્ય રીતે જાળવેલી continuous pressurised supply માં intrusion risk ઘટે છે; intermittent operation માં low pressure વખતે leaks મારફતે contamination પ્રવેશી શકે છે અને controlled storage જરૂરી બને છે. Maintenance વગર કોઈ પણ નામ safe water ની ખાતરી નથી.

body.en:
Valves and functions:

  • Sluice/gate valve isolates a section; it is not generally used for precise throttling.
  • Check/non-return valve prevents reverse flow; a dedicated approved backflow-prevention assembly may still be required.
  • Air valve releases or admits air at suitable points; scour/washout valve drains or flushes low points.
  • Pressure-reducing valve limits downstream pressure; a relief valve protects against excessive pressure as designed.

Meters: mechanical displacement or velocity meters and electromagnetic/ultrasonic meters measure flow using different principles. Choose according to flow range, accuracy, installation and maintenance. Bends, tees, reducers, couplings, unions and taps connect or control pipework; fixtures must be suitable for potable water and pressure.
body.gu:
Valves અને functions:

  • Sluice/gate valve section isolate કરે છે; સામાન્ય રીતે precise throttling માટે વપરાતો નથી.
  • Check/non-return valve reverse flow અટકાવે છે; અલગ approved backflow-prevention assembly હજુ જરૂરી હોઈ શકે.
  • Air valve યોગ્ય points પર air છોડે અથવા અંદર લે છે; scour/washout valve low points ને drain અથવા flush કરે છે.
  • Pressure-reducing valve downstream pressure મર્યાદિત કરે છે; relief valve design મુજબ અતિશય pressure સામે રક્ષણ આપે છે.

Meters: mechanical displacement અથવા velocity meters અને electromagnetic/ultrasonic meters જુદા principles થી flow માપે છે. Flow range, accuracy, installation અને maintenance મુજબ પસંદ કરો. Bends, tees, reducers, couplings, unions અને taps pipework જોડે અથવા control કરે છે; fixtures potable water અને pressure માટે યોગ્ય હોવાં જોઈએ.

title.en: Numerical 4.1 — Velocity and flow in a main
title.gu: Numerical 4.1 — Main માં velocity અને flow

body.en:
Given: A circular main of internal diameter 200 mm carries water at mean velocity 1.5 m/s. Find flow in L/s.

Step 1. Convert diameter and calculate cross-sectional area.

D = 200 / 1000D = 0.20 mA = πD² / 4A = π × 0.20² / 4A ≈ 0.03142 m²

Step 2. Calculate flow and convert units.

Q = AVQ = 0.03142 × 1.5Q ≈ 0.04712 m³/sQ ≈ 0.04712 × 1000 L/s

Final answer:

Flow ≈ 47.12 L/s.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Internal diameter 200 mm ધરાવતો circular main mean velocity 1.5 m/s પર પાણી વહન કરે છે. Flow ને L/s માં શોધો.

Step 1. Diameter ફેરવી cross-sectional area ગણો.

D = 200 / 1000D = 0.20 mA = πD² / 4A = π × 0.20² / 4A ≈ 0.03142 m²

Step 2. Flow ગણી units ફેરવો.

Q = AVQ = 0.03142 × 1.5Q ≈ 0.04712 m³/sQ ≈ 0.04712 × 1000 L/s

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Flow ≈ 47.12 L/s.

title.en: Formulae, methods and key data — Unit 4
title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 4

body.en:
Use internal diameter and consistent units; actual losses require a suitable hydraulic equation.

A = πD² / 4Q = AV1 m³/s = 1000 L/s

Internal diameter અને સુસંગત units વાપરો; actual losses માટે યોગ્ય hydraulic equation જરૂરી છે.

A = πD² / 4Q = AV1 m³/s = 1000 L/s
